title: script.create_story_skeleton_version input
description: Appends a skeleton version for an episode, with the story events it selects. The version is a draft: this tool cannot approve it, which is the user's gate.

episodeId.description: The episode this version belongs to.

basedOnVersionId.description: The version this one revises, or empty for the first.

turningPointsJson.description: The turning points, as a JSON array.

selectedEventIds.description: The story events this skeleton selects, by id. They are written as a link table, so which events an episode contains is a query that can be asked. An id this project does not have fails the call.

changeReason.description: Why this version exists, in one sentence.
